pretreatments.description: Thermo-alkaline pretreatment: 1% (w/v) NaOH solution at 70 °C for 48 h, combined with a glass bottle heating system.
Anaerobic digestion: Mesophilic (35 ± 1 °C) or thermophilic (55 ± 1 °C) incubation with inoculum (granular sludge from a paper mill) for 100 days, with manual shaking once daily.
